opening.argument: The video solicits participation in Forsage while tying entry and increased earning potential to Ether deposits and activated slots. Viewers are told to “deposit enough ether to register and then activate the amount of slots that you want one by one,” and that “The more slots you activate the more ETH you can earn.” Its payment structure is a tiered matrix: payments depend on numbered spots, reopened slots, and an upline. The pitch further promises Ethereum paid “daily” and “directly and instantly” to the viewer’s wallet, alongside potential earnings of 1,000 Ethereum or more. The statement that income is not guaranteed qualifies the result, but does not remove the earnings-and-deposit solicitation.
